shots.title: Morning Courtyard Establishing Shot
shots.visual_summary: Wide establishing view of a quiet stone courtyard bathed in soft morning light as mist lifts above the tiles.
shots.lighting: Soft diffused dawn daylight with cool shadows and gentle atmospheric haze.
action_beats: 0.0-2.0s: Still courtyard bathed in pale morning light.
2.0-4.0s: Light breeze ripples leaves along the courtyard wall.
shots.audio_notes: Ambient morning breeze and distant leaves rustling.

shots.title: Tabletop Teacup Focus Pull

camera.focus_pull: Foreground wooden table edge -> ceramic teacup in midground

shots.visual_summary: Close-up across a weathered wooden table as focus shifts smoothly onto a warm ceramic teacup releasing faint steam.
shots.lighting: Soft window side-light highlighting thin rising wisps of steam.
action_beats: 0.0-1.5s: Foreground wood grain crisp; background teacup softly blurred.
1.5-3.0s: Focus pulls smoothly back onto the teacup rim.
3.0-4.0s: Steam curls gently upward in morning light.
shots.audio_notes: Quiet room tone with subtle wind outside the window.

shots.title: Paper Boat Gliding Down a Stream
shots.visual_summary: A folded white paper boat drifts smoothly along a clear pebble stream bordered by green ferns.
shots.lighting: Dappled sunlight filtering through overhead foliage onto moving water.
action_beats: 0.0-2.5s: Paper boat enters from frame left and glides over submerged pebbles.
2.5-5.0s: Camera pans smoothly right as the boat turns past a mossy stone.
shots.audio_notes: Soft babbling stream water and gentle foliage breeze.
